419:t_2:35.en:
$n
「It's all right, $$カレン$$. $$宗介$$ is keeping me from getting carried away.」

419:t_2:36.en:
$$宗介$$
「What do you intend to do, $n?」

419:t_2:37.en:
$n
「...Right now, I don't know what I should do.」

419:t_2:38.en:
$n
「But I'll rescue Miss $$スズネ$$, whatever it takes.」

419:t_2:39.en:
$$竜馬$$
「No... We can't leave rescuing Miss $$スズネ$$ to you alone.」

419:t_2:40.en:
$$甲児$$
「She's the darling of the $$ボランティア部$$, after all.」

419:t_2:41.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$ワッ太$$, $$正太郎$$, $$アマタ$$, and the others will get fired up if we're rescuing Miss $$スズネ$$ too.」

419:t_2:42.en:
$n
「Then we'll do it together, no matter what $$バルビエル$$ tries.」

419:t_2:43.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Now this is getting fun! Do your best, everyone!」

419:t_2:44.en:
$n
(I'll do what I have to do, without clinging to convenient hopes or lashing out in despair...)

419:t_2:45.en:
$n
(Miss $$スズネ$$... For me, that means rescuing you.)

419:t_2:46.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Man, I was surprised. I never knew $$ランド$$ had worries or fears.」

419:t_2:47.en:
$$ランド$$
「Adults don't let that stuff show.」

419:t_2:48.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Maybe you're right. $$ジャミル$$ was like that too.」

419:t_2:49.en:
$$パーラ$$
「So adults don't just drink and act superior to young people, huh?」

419:t_2:50.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well... We need to blow off steam.」

419:t_2:51.en:
$$メール$$
「What are you talking about, Darling!? You guzzle beer to blow off steam, and our business is always in the red because of it!」

419:t_2:52.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't get so angry, $$メール$$. It's rough on $$ランド$$ if you keep bringing up money.」

419:t_2:54.en:
$n
「You'll have to put up with spending a little if it's for $$ランド$$'s smile.」

419:t_2:55.en:
$$メール$$
「That's unfair! You're ganging up on me four to one!」

419:t_2:56.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That is a beautiful show of cooperation between $$リアクター$$s.」

419:t_2:57.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「So they're all on the same level.」

419:t_2:58.en:
$$ランド$$
「Anyway, thanks, $$セツコ$$, $$クロウ$$, and $n.」

419:t_2:59.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No need to thank us. You showed us how to get past our own wall.」

419:t_2:61.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Yes... I feel the same indescribable anxiety that you and $n feel, $$ランド$$.」

419:t_2:62.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It seems that's why the final doors of our machines won't open.」

419:t_2:63.en:
$$ランド$$
「So it's an illness unique to $$リアクター$$s?」

419:t_2:64.en:
$$クロウ$$
「As if fearing the backlash wasn't enough, you throw that in too? You're giving us way too much, Mr. $$スフィア$$...」

419:t_2:68.en:
$n
「I was thinking I should follow $$ランド$$'s example and keep trying too.」

419:t_2:69.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's the spirit, young man! You keep walking the path to manhood too!」

419:t_2:71.en:
$n
(If that anxiety is unique to $$リアクター$$s, what was Miss $$スズネ$$ so afraid of...?)

419:t_2:72.en:
$n
(Does it have something to do with her no longer feeling anxious just before she was abducted...?)

419:t_2:73.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Come on, everyone! Today we're having a farewell party for $c!」

419:t_2:74.en:
$$クルツ$$
「We just had a welcome party, and now it's a farewell party!?」

419:t_2:76.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ would welcome a party every day!」

419:t_2:80.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Hard work, guts, fighting spirit, and overbearing enthusiasm... These guys all belong in the same group...」

419:t_2:81.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You should have fun too, Big Sis! It is a party, after all!」

419:t_2:82.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...You're right. It's nice that this beautiful green sea is peaceful now.」

419:t_2:83.en:
$$メルティ$$
「We'll have plenty of food ready too!」

419:t_2:84.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「And of course, we'll be dancing.」

419:t_2:85.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Are you going to dance again too, $$ティファ$$!?」

419:t_2:87.en:
$$ガロード$$
「All right!! Long live parties!!」

419:t_2:89.en:
$$宗介$$
「Even if they serve octopus, don't draw your gun this time, $$レド$$.」

419:t_2:92.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「$c leaves tomorrow! I'm gonna drink tonight!」

419:t_2:94.en:
$$レド$$
「Yeah... And someday, let's come back to $$ガルガンティア$$.」

419:t_2:95.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Yes...! We'll definitely be together then, $$レド$$.」

419:t_10:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...What is with that $$エルーナルーナ$$...?」

419:t_10:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We never could have imagined it when she was covered in armor.」

419:t_10:5.en:
$n
「No matter how good she is at commanding, I can see why they'd think she shouldn't be in charge of the military...」

419:t_10:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I actually sympathized with $$皇帝アウストラリス$$ a little.」

419:t_10:7.en:
$n
「I feel sorry for $$ランド$$. She's going to be following him around.」

419:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Well, everyone... $$エルーナルーナ$$'s appearance has stirred up quite a few things, and moved each of your hearts deeply.」

419:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That generated 100 Z of $$Ｚチップ$$s! I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

419:t_10:12.en:
$$セツコ$$
「If you took off your armor, $$ＡＧ$$, there wouldn't be something inside... would there?」

419:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How naughty! So you're thinking about stripping off my armor, are you?」

419:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm sorry to disappoint you, but I'm only a robot...」

419:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm no surprise-filled treasure box with a glamorous beauty inside like that.」

419:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There you have it, $n. Please don't entertain indecent fantasies about me.」

419:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... Please spare me a $$ブーストアップ$$ punishment...!」

kept_omissions: 419:t_2:60: Rand begins asking whether Crowe and Setsuko feel the same anxiety, leaving the predicate unfinished.
uncertain: 419:t_2:57: Dorothy is the Big O android, established by Roger immediately before her reply; selected #bigo speaker.
